docs.title: Overview
docs.text: A differential drive robot with full SLAM and autonomous navigation built on ROS2 Jazzy, running on Raspberry Pi with ESP32 motor controller.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• 360° laser scan from dual VL53L0X sensors merged via ros2_laser_scan_merger
  • Full Nav2 stack with MPPI controller
  • Hardware E-stop with GPIO watchdog
  • micro-ROS over serial for ESP32 communication
